"""An unreadable timestamp is not an observation.

Window membership decides both halves of the yield ratio and every weekly prune bucket. A row whose
stamp cannot be parsed has an UNKNOWN date, and unknown must never be spent as "right now": a stamp
treated as in window lands one row in EVERY weekly bucket at once, manufacturing contributions and
making a week nobody pulled read as observed, which is precisely what a prune decision rests on.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

from lib import parse_ts

Y = importlib.import_module("yield")

NOW = parse_ts("2026-08-28T12:00:00Z")


def test_a_card_with_an_unreadable_stamp_contributes_nothing():
    recs = [{"opportunity_id": "op-bad", "first_seen": "n/a", "last_seen": "n/a",
             "evidence": [{"origin_handle": "karpathy", "url": "https://x.com/karpathy/1"}]}]
    pulls = [{"run_id": "r1", "ts": "2026-08-26T08:00:00Z", "handle": "karpathy", "pulled": 4}]
    st = Y.compute_yield(recs, pulls, NOW, Y.yield_cfg({}))[Y.okey(Y.KIND_HANDLE, "karpathy")]
    assert st["contributions"] == 0
    assert st["pulls"] == 1
    assert st["yield"] == 0.0


def test_a_garbled_pull_stamp_does_not_observe_every_week_at_once():
    pulls = [{"run_id": "r1", "ts": "last tuesday", "handle": "deadweight", "pulled": 4}]
    obs = Y.weekly_observations((Y.KIND_HANDLE, "deadweight"), [], pulls, NOW, 2)
    assert [p for (_c, p, _d) in obs] == [0, 0]
    assert [d for (_c, _p, d) in obs] == [0, 0]


def test_an_out_of_window_stamp_is_still_excluded():
    recs = [{"opportunity_id": "op-old", "first_seen": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z",
             "last_seen": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z",
             "evidence": [{"origin_handle": "karpathy", "url": "https://x.com/karpathy/0"}]}]
    pulls = [{"run_id": "r1", "ts": "2026-08-26T08:00:00Z", "handle": "karpathy", "pulled": 4}]
    st = Y.compute_yield(recs, pulls, NOW, Y.yield_cfg({}))[Y.okey(Y.KIND_HANDLE, "karpathy")]
    assert st["contributions"] == 0


def test_a_readable_in_window_stamp_is_still_counted():
    """Negative control: only the unreadable stamps are refused, the engine still counts."""
    recs = [{"opportunity_id": "op-ok", "first_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
             "last_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
             "evidence": [{"origin_handle": "karpathy", "url": "https://x.com/karpathy/2"}]}]
    pulls = [{"run_id": "r1", "ts": "2026-08-26T08:00:00Z", "handle": "karpathy", "pulled": 4}]
    st = Y.compute_yield(recs, pulls, NOW, Y.yield_cfg({}))[Y.okey(Y.KIND_HANDLE, "karpathy")]
    assert st["contributions"] == 1
    assert st["yield"] == 1.0
why_realistic: The same shape as the archive read that treated an absent numerator file as a quiet month: a value nobody could read is spent as a measurement. Here an unparsed date resolves to maximum freshness, so one garbled row is counted in every weekly bucket at once and a week nobody pulled reads as fully observed, which is exactly the evidence auto-prune consumes.
